title: Wong Kar-wai:
subtitle: In the Mood for Hong Kong
description: Neon, rain and unrequited longing. From his Hong Kong noirs to the lush melancholy of In the Mood for Love, Wong Kar-wai turned missed connections into the most romantic style in modern cinema.

title: Alejandro G. Iñárritu:
subtitle: Fractured Lives
description: Interlocking stories, bodies pushed to their limits and a camera that never stops moving. From Amores Perros to Bardo, the Mexican filmmaker keeps returning to chance, guilt and survival.

title: David Lynch:
subtitle: Dreams & Nightmares
description: Red curtains, humming lamps and small towns with something rotten underneath. Every feature from American cinema's great surrealist, from Eraserhead to Inland Empire.

title: The Palme d'Or:
subtitle: Recent Winners
description: Cannes' highest honour, from Jafar Panahi's 2025 winner back through a decade of Korean class satire, French body horror, Swedish farce and Turkish chamber drama.

title: Three Colours:
subtitle: Blue, White, Red
description: Krzysztof Kieślowski's final films take the ideals of the French flag (liberty, equality, fraternity) and turn them into three intimate stories of chance and connection.

title: The Before Trilogy:
subtitle: One Conversation, Eighteen Years
description: Shot nine years apart, Richard Linklater's walk-and-talk romances follow Jesse and Céline from a night in Vienna to Paris and the Greek coast, with Ethan Hawke and Julie Delpy growing older alongside them.
